clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Korran seeks silithid eggs for study. The Horde scholar at the Crossroads has heard of intelligent insect creatures in the south and wants intact eggs brought to Orgrimmar.

Korran watches the Barrens from the Crossroads and reports to Orgrimmar. While the Horde faces tribal conflicts and Alliance incursions, he studies strange changes in the land. Intelligent, hive-minded insect creatures have begun burrowing into the southern Barrens.

Korran needs samples to learn where the silithid come from and what drives them. With an excavation claw, you go to the Field of Giants and take intact eggs from the dirt mounds. Disturbing a mound draws the nearby brood to defend it, showing the swarm's uncanny coordination.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, friend. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.
Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be careful with the eggs you find, friend. If they break, they be no good to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You please me, friend. The eggs and the tool. Well done.
